name: agents-progress
description: Progress bar above the prompt whenever subagents run, with a spiky-haired mascot per model that powers up from Haiku to Fable; its arrow folds out the list of subagents with model, steps, cost, tokens and time. Adapted from savvy-progress, without savvy-flow.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language before any flag is picked; the flag at the foot of the agents list (US, FR, ES) sets it and is remembered across sessions. auto is English; en, fr, es, ru or he (Hebrew, drawn right to left)

formHaiku.title: Mascot form for Haiku agents
formHaiku.description: Which head the mascot wears on Haiku: base (Normal: black hair, no aura), charged (golden hair and aura), super (blue hair, bolts) or ultimate (red hair, flames, streaks)
